title: Read-only office package availability planner
objective: Produce a deterministic, read-only office package plan from caller-supplied APT availability metadata for each supported distro profile.
acceptance_criteria: All seven supported profiles have package candidate groups
Unknown and unavailable packages are never selected
Plan is deterministic for identical inputs
All execution flags remain false and packages_to_install remains empty
Tests cover unknown profile, malformed input, missing availability, unavailable candidate and deterministic selection
safety_invariants: No subprocess or package manager invocation
No package installation or system mutation
Human approval required for any future execution capability
evidence: Source and tests committed on project/linux-transition-foundry branch
